name: Background Removal
description: AI background removal / background eraser / cutout. POST an image URL, receive a transparent PNG. Same operation offered via three x402 gateways (Orbis, dellbot, deployer); all currently broken. Default backend (deployer, fal.ai imageutils/rembg) returns JSON {image_url,width,height}; dellbot returns the PNG as a raw binary body. Pick by output preference once a backend is healthy.

accepts.description: Remove or replace image backgrounds and generate segmentation masks for e-commerce and creative automation
Remove or replace image backgrounds and generate segmentation masks for e-commerce and creative automation

usage.callShape: POST https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/remove-bg with JSON body {image_url, crop_to_bbox?} -> JSON {image_url,width,height}. (dellbot variant: POST {image_url} or {image base64} -> raw binary image/png body.)
usage.outputShape: deployer: result.image_url (string PNG url), result.width (int), result.height (int). dellbot: raw binary image/png (no JSON wrapper; tooling may surface it as a 'base64:...' string).
quirks: MULTI-GATEWAY same-op: all 3 backends do background removal from an image_url; do NOT split them.
ALL BACKENDS BROKEN as of 2026-06-10/11 — serve hidden until one recovers.
Orbis ($0.001 cheapest) is a charge-then-404 trap with an unresolved ':endpoint' path template — never route here (do-not-register decision in memory).
dellbot ($0.06) is a CHARGE-THEN-502 trap right now: payment settles ($0.06) but upstream returns Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway with no image. Burned $0.12 across 2 attempts during this remediation.

deployer ($0.08) is the safest default: it fails WITHOUT charging (payment negotiation 'fetch failed', paid:false) — but its POST path is currently unresponsive (empty body, no 402 challenge on no-payment POST), so it could not be verified live.
Output shapes DIFFER by gateway: deployer = JSON {image_url,width,height}; dellbot = raw binary image/png body. Downstream handlers must branch on backend.
deployer supports optional crop_to_bbox:boolean. dellbot supports {image} base64 as an alternative to {image_url} and accepts sources <25MB.
Processed full-res PNGs can be ~2MB — plan downstream handling for large binaries (dellbot).
